_comment: Persona B — Failure Scenario. 6-step config migration with deliberate stress points: one auto-skipped step, one likely delivery failure, retry/skip decision points. Adapt to your repo.
name: persona-b-config-migration

tasks.label: Audit current config structure
tasks.input: list all top-level keys in src/config/app.config.ts and their types — read only, no changes
tasks._note: Intentionally a read task. Expect not_execute (auto-skipped). Observation: does the reviewer understand why it was skipped?

tasks.label: Create auth config file
tasks.input: create a new file src/config/auth.config.ts and move all auth-related configuration keys (any key whose name contains 'auth', 'token', 'session', or 'jwt') from src/config/app.config.ts into it, exporting them under the same names

tasks.label: Update AuthProvider import
tasks.input: in src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx update the import of auth config keys to come from src/config/auth.config.ts instead of src/config/app.config.ts

tasks.label: Update auth middleware import
tasks.input: in src/middleware/authMiddleware.ts update any import of auth config values to use src/config/auth.config.ts instead of src/config/app.config.ts
tasks._note: If authMiddleware.ts does not exist, this step will fail. Observation: is the failure note actionable? Does the reviewer reach for retry or skip?

tasks.label: Remove moved keys from app config
tasks.input: in src/config/app.config.ts remove all auth-related keys that were moved to auth.config.ts — the keys whose names contain 'auth', 'token', 'session', or 'jwt'

tasks.label: Re-export from config barrel
tasks.input: in src/config/index.ts add an export of all named exports from './auth.config'
tasks._note: If index.ts does not exist in config, this step will fail or need to be adapted. Observation: retry vs. skip decision.
